name: genai
description: The GenAI domain pack: LLM-application observability. Extracted (E13, docs/decisions/011) from sixteen literals scattered across oah/cli.py, oah/design/gates.py, oah/discovery/gap_model.py, oah/discovery/registry.py and five schemas -- this manifest is the seam that extraction introduced, re-expressing this pack's existing behavior with zero change to it. Scoped to exactly what KIND_TO_DIMENSION and LENS_TO_POINT_KIND covered before extraction; surface_map.schema.json's other five kinds (agent_loop, queue_producer, queue_consumer, guardrail, human_review_hook) are not yet owned by any pack and are deliberately left out here rather than added with a guessed dimension.

registries.confidence_note: Suffix match on the last two attribute-chain segments (not the full dotted path) -- resolves client.beta.prompt_caching.messages.create correctly without enumerating every beta-namespace prefix by hand. Grounded in the SP1 spike's real 3-repo corpus (docs/decisions/003), 100% recall.

Same suffix shape as the python entry above -- the SDK's call surface is the same across languages, only sdk_module differs. Grounded in the SP10 spike's real 3-repo TS corpus (docs/decisions/004) plus a fourth repo added for SP12 (docs/decisions/013), 100% recall (14/14, 0 FP) across all three TS detector shapes combined. E11-TS (docs/decisions/014) is what actually consumes this entry -- oah/discovery/registry.py filters registries by language.

Real, verified via a background research agent against the official README (docs/decisions/029, https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-java, package com.anthropic:anthropic-java), NOT corpus-verified. Client construction is a STATIC BUILDER CHAIN, not `new X()` -- `AnthropicOkHttpClient.builder().apiKey(...).build()` or the shorter `AnthropicOkHttpClient.fromEnv()` -- the first registry entry in this project needing detector_shape: static_builder_chain rather than receiver_method_suffix/module_function_call. Call shape (`client.messages().create(params)`/`.stream(params)`) is identical to the Python/TS entries above. Async is a genuinely separate client/call surface (`AnthropicClientAsync`/`AnthropicOkHttpClientAsync`, or `.async()` inserted as an extra hop on a sync client, e.g. `client.async().messages().create(...)`) -- both covered: the async client classes are also declared as chain roots here (same module/terminals), and the `.async()`-hop-on-sync-client form is covered for free since suffix matching only checks the chain's tail. `AnthropicClient` (the interface, never itself chain-called) is included in constructor_names only so a constructor-injected already-typed field/parameter (`AnthropicClient client` with no visible construction in this file) still resolves via annotation_sdk -- the same trust every adapter already extends to a typed parameter.

The classic pre-v3 Pinecone SDK shape (pinecone.Index(...).query(...)), a direct single-hop constructor call. Deliberately NOT the v3+ Pinecone() client-object SDK, which needs multi-hop receiver tracking this adapter doesn't do yet -- a stated, current scope boundary.
create_feedback is LangSmith's own real method name for binding user/reviewer verdicts to a trace/run ID -- architecture.md's feedback lens description verbatim.

Grounded in LiveKit's public SDK docs/quickstart shape, not independently verified against a live corpus the way the anthropic registry was. connect is a more generic verb than pinecone's query, so this registry raises the ambiguous-candidate rate the most of the four -- accepted, not free.

"tool_use" is Anthropic's own real content-block-type string (the Messages API's response shape) -- a structurally different detection strategy from every registry-based check above, since a tool_use dispatch site is application-defined logic reacting to a response's own content, not a call into a client. Not receiver-resolved, so treated as real but lower-confidence than a resolved-receiver signature match. Python-only: no TS evidence exists for this pattern (E11-TS's own stated scope boundary, docs/decisions/014).

semconv_namespaces.pin: not yet pinned to a specific commit/tag -- see docs/decisions/001-sp6-otel-genai-semconv-maturity.md (Option B: pin every run, treat the whole namespace as Development until a first Stable attribute or tagged release lands)
